title: Judging the Judges: Evaluating Alignment and Vulnerabilities in LLMs-as-Judges

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the probability that a judge model defaults to a 'correct' evaluation when its criteria are not fully aligned with instructions, calculated mathematically using empirical true positive and true negative rates compared to human ground-truth.

Shuffling the order of reference answers in the prompt across three different permutations and computing the consistency score of the judge model to see if it favors references appearing earlier in the prompt.
